messages:
rhea: Pushed a slim-nav mock and a short routing appendix. Goal: 3 primary groups, utility rail, and stable permalinks. Figma: https://figma.com/file/slimnav RFC: /docs/nav-guidelines.md :wave:

idan: Nice. Quick question about legacy links — we still have a lot of bookmarks to /console/models/:id and /console/models/:id/versions. Plan?

ori: Recommend server 301s for public pages + client-side canonicalize fallback during rollout. Keep a rewrite table and return `X-Deprecated-Path` header for observability.

sam: accessibility: when groups collapse ensure focus moves to the toggle and announce state with `aria-live="polite"`. Also ensure `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on group buttons. Mobile hit target >=44px.

design-bot: [contrast-check] collapsed chevron ratio 3.6:1 < 4.5:1. Suggest thicker stroke or lighter fill. Also missing aria-label on utility toggle.

ori: small helper for client fallback: `function normalizeIncoming(url){ const p = url.pathname!="/"?url.pathname: new URL(url).hash.replace('#',''); return stripLegacyFragments(p) }` Use before router.resolve.

dan: breadcrumb microcopy: prefer `Models / MyModel / Versions` (slash) and ellipsize middle crumbs. Track breadcrumb_click metric.

rhea: routing priority for RFC: 1) exact new path, 2) server rewrite/301, 3) client canonicalize -> query fallback, 4) hash fallback, 5) global search fallback.

rhea: actionables: (1) Ori draft rewrite header + 301 table (owner: ori, due: Wed), (2) Sam write keyboard/ARIA checklist and mobile hit targets (owner: sam, due: Tue), (3) Dan add breadcrumb telemetry + microcopy QA (owner: dan, due: Tue). Will update figma with contrast fix after that. :thumbsup:
